# Brex — account brief

## Who
Brex offers corporate cards and spend management software for startups and enterprises ([source](https://brex.com/)). Its GitHub org profile lists the company as Brex at brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).

## Production Expo signals
- `eas.json` is committed in `brexhq/brex-mobile` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/eas.json)).
- `package.json` in that repo pins react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)).
- The repo has CI workflows under `.github/workflows` ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/tree/main/.github/workflows)).
- The org has 27 public repos and 410 followers ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).
- The org description names a regulated category, "financial" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq)).
- The iOS app has 28,000 App Store ratings ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- There have been 7 App Store releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)).
- An open issue in the repo reads "expo upgrade to SDK 52 blocked by native module mismatch" ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).
- Brex links a careers page from its homepage ([source](https://brex.com/careers)). No hiring evidence for React Native or Expo roles was found.

## Who to talk to
- Maintainer One (@brexhq-maintainer-1), top contributor to `brexhq/brex-mobile` with 260 commits ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). Their GitHub profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- Maintainer Two (@brexhq-maintainer-2), 133 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). Their profile lists company "Brex" and website https://brex.com ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-2)). No title, team, or location in the evidence.
- @brexhq-maintainer-3, 58 commits to the same repo ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-3)). The evidence gives no name, company, or bio for this profile.

## Why now
`brexhq/brex-mobile` was last pushed on 2026-08-15 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile)), and the App Store listing shows 7 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). The repo is on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)) with an open issue about an SDK 52 upgrade blocked by a native module mismatch ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)).

## Suggested opener
You have 260 commits in `brexhq/brex-mobile`, which builds through EAS on react-native 0.74.5 ([source](https://github.com/brexhq-maintainer-1)) ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/blob/main/package.json)). Issue 87 in that repo says the upgrade to SDK 52 is blocked by a native module mismatch ([source](https://github.com/brexhq/brex-mobile/issues/87)), and the App Store listing shows 7 releases in the last 90 days ([source](https://apps.apple.com/us/app/brex/id1472293141)). Is that module something a config plugin and a development build could cover, or is it the reason the upgrade is parked?
